title: Database connection pool exhausted
description: PostgreSQL cannot provide more connections because the pool limit has been reached.

title: Slow SQL query
description: A SELECT query exceeded the configured statement execution deadline.

title: Java heap space exhausted
description: A JVM worker terminated with OutOfMemoryError.

title: Heap allocation failure
description: The worker cannot allocate additional memory for incoming requests.

title: DNS lookup returned NXDOMAIN
description: The internal hostname cannot be resolved by the configured resolver.

title: TLS handshake failure
description: The proxy could not establish a TLS session with the upstream server.

title: HTTP 403 Forbidden
description: An authenticated user lacks permission to access the admin endpoint.

title: OAuth refresh token rejected
description: The identity provider rejected the expired refresh credential.

title: TypeError in request handler
description: Request processing failed because an object is not iterable.

title: Worker terminated with SIGSEGV
description: A native application worker exited with a segmentation fault.

title: Unexpected system behavior
description: Users reported issues but no logs or diagnostic evidence are available.

title: Unidentified alert
description: Monitoring raised an alert without identifying any affected component.
